preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract
Contract must hold NFT tokens that can be withdrawn

exploit_hint: Call the withdrawNft function with: (1) token_ parameter set to the NFT contract address, (2) destination_ parameter set to attacker's address, (3) tokenId_ parameter set to the specific NFT token ID to withdraw. The owner can extract any NFT held by the contract regardless of who originally deposited it.
